# Security advisories that pip-audit is told to accept for Pillow, and why.
#
# Pillow 13 fixes all of these and cannot be installed yet: fastembed (needed for the embeddings) still says pillow<13.
# The service opens only JPEG, PNG, WebP and HEIC pictures (photos.IMAGE_FORMATS, by what the file really is, not by its name)
# and saves only PNG, so the problems of the other readers and writers (GIF, TIFF, EPS, PPM, PDF, XBM, MSP, BMP, SPIDER, MIC,
# WMF, TAR, fonts, JPEG saving) cannot be reached. The two that concern PNG are kept out by photos.check_png.
# When fastembed allows Pillow 13: raise pillow in requirements.txt, delete this file and the pip-audit option that reads it.
# A new advisory is added here only after checking that the code it concerns cannot be reached, and with its reason.
